fields.name: stats
fields.description: Detailed output of data per minute for each hero.

args.name: heroIds
args.description: An array of hero ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these heroes.

args.name: week
args.description: The week to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include this week. The value is an epoc TimeStamp of the week of data you want. Leaving null gives the current week.

args.name: bracketBasicIds
args.description: An array of rank ids to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these ranks. The value ranges from 0-8 with 0 being unknown MMR and 1-8 is low to high MMR brackets. Example 7 is Divine.

args.name: positionIds
args.description: An array of positions ids (enum MatchPlayerPositionType) to include in this query, excluding all results that do not include one of these lanes.

args.name: minTime
args.description: Integer in minutes which determines the start of the data. For example, 10 would result in every event after 10:00 mark in-game. Minimum input value is 0.

args.name: maxTime
args.description: Integer in minutes which determines the start of the data. For example, 10 would result in every event before 10:00 mark in-game Maximum input value is 75.
